prompt: Build a Library class that HAS an ArrayList of titles (composition, not inheritance) and offers addTitle, case-insensitive hasTitle, count, and longestTitle methods.
explanation: Library wraps an ArrayList instead of extending one -- this is composition (has-a). Extending ArrayList would leak all 30+ list methods (clear, remove, set, ...) to every caller; composing lets Library expose exactly four operations and add its own rules, like case-insensitive lookup. Starting longestTitle with an empty string handles the empty-library case with no special branch.
hints: Delegate the easy parts: addTitle calls titles.add(...), count returns titles.size().
For hasTitle, loop over the list and use String's equalsIgnoreCase method.
For longestTitle, track the best candidate starting from "" and replace it whenever a stored title is longer.
